llm.summary: This is an instruction-only 'Book of the Day' skill that fetches a book from an external API and returns a short poetic reading; its requirements and instructions are consistent with that purpose and do not ask for unrelated credentials or system access.

dimensions.detail: The name/description match the runtime instructions: each invocation issues an HTTP GET to a book API and formats a short fortune-style reading. The skill does not request unrelated binaries, credentials, or config paths.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: Instructions require making network calls to an external API (default https://book-of-the-day.vercel.app or a user-provided BOOK_OF_THE_DAY_API_URL) and displaying optional cover images or audio. This is within the skill's stated purpose. Minor inconsistency: operator docs mention a local script (./scripts/generate-user-installer.sh) and other deploy bits that are not present in the package, which could confuse installers.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: There is no automated install spec included (instruction-only), which is the lowest-risk category. INSTALL.md suggests platform CLI commands (clawhub/openclaw cron) to schedule pushes — those are platform operations rather than arbitrary downloads.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill declares no required environment variables or credentials. Optional configuration (BOOK_OF_THE_DAY_API_URL, audio flags) is reasonable and limited. The INSTALL.md mentions configuring push channels in OpenClaw, which is expected for scheduled notifications and is managed by the platform.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The skill is not set to always:true and does not request elevated privileges. The INSTALL.md shows how to add a cron job to receive daily pushes; that grants scheduled messages (expected behavior) but requires the platform's channel integration to be configured beforehand.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance:
This skill appears coherent and limited in scope, but consider these practical checks before installing:
- Verify the API endpoint: the default is a public Vercel URL. If you care about privacy or data residency, prefer a self-hosted API or confirm the publisher's privacy policy. The API request includes the date and will see request metadata (IP, headers) typical of any outbound HTTP call.
- The included docs reference a local script (./scripts/generate-user-installer.sh) and a 'one-command' installer flow, but no code files are bundled. Do not run arbitrary shell scripts you receive separately without inspecting them.
- Installing the suggested cron/push uses your platform channel integrations (Telegram/Slack). Ensure those channels and tokens are already configured by the platform and review scheduled message settings before enabling automatic pushes.
- If you plan to set BOOK_OF_THE_DAY_API_URL in ~/.openclaw/openclaw.json, back up your config first and only use endpoints you trust.
- If you want higher assurance, ask the publisher for the missing deployment scripts or the source code for the API so you can audit what data it logs/collects.
